title: C-RADIOv4 (Tech Report)
mechanism: Agglomerative ViT distilled from SigLIP2, DINOv3 and SAM3; any-resolution support and a ViTDet windowed mode for cheap high-resolution inference; permissive licence.
evidence: R (abstract): improves over RADIOv2.5 at same cost. Web (unverified from paper): ADE20k linear probe 55.2 / 57.0 at 512 / 1024 px.
adaptation: Backbone swap in VFM-H with no gated download; ViTDet mode at 1024 px; SO400M first.
min_experiment: C-RADIOv4-SO400M vs DINOv3-L vs SAM2 Hiera-L in the best PEFT arm; drop a backbone if E1 relF1@2 is more than 0.02 below the best.
